programs.description: Major Mukund Varadarajan, a commissioned officer in the Rajput Regiment of the Indian Army, conducts a counterterrorism operation while being deployed to Jammu and Kashmir.
Raghava, who fears the dark and is afraid of ghosts, gets possessed by three spirits who want him to take revenge on their murderer.
